references.text: The Feast of Tabernacles was to be celebrated for seven days for the Lord, with a holy assembly on the eighth day
Describes a seven-day celebration for the Lord during the Feast of Tabernacles
The command to rejoice before the Lord in the place he chooses
The place that the Lord chooses to set his name there
Rejoicing before the Lord in the place he has chosen
The Lord's blessing over the harvest and all work
An encouragement to rejoice on the day the Lord has made
Joy in the Lord as a blessing from God
Joy in the Lord is the people's strength during the feast
An encouragement to always rejoice in the Lord
